maria (eng-platform): Quick Q — we're planning to add cache-aware fields to the usage response for /v1/usage. Current consumer contracts expect prompt_tokens and completion_tokens. Product wants cached_prompt_tokens and cached_completion_tokens too. Any concerns about billing or SDK breakage?

kevin (runtime): I don't love adding derived fields. Prefer we emit raw: prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cached_tokens (single object or list) + cache_breakdown metadata. Let consumers compute totals. That way we avoid subtle discrepancies.

nina (devex): Important: if we introduce new field names we must keep the old ones; recommend a response header for schema versioning, e.g. `X-Redwood-Usage-Version: 2`. Also document behavior for null/missing cached fields.

sam (billing): For accounting we currently derive billed = prompt + completion - cached_prefix. Mapping is straightforward if you expose cached_* split. Two things: 1) please ensure we never produce negative billed tokens (we clamp to 0 in billing). 2) we should add an explicit `billing_basis` string in the response to state what formula was used.

kevin (runtime): Plan proposal: add optional fields `cached_prompt_tokens` and `cached_completion_tokens` (nullable), keep `prompt_tokens`/`completion_tokens` exactly as-is, and add `usage_schema_version` in response body. No breaking renames. Also add a short example in the API docs.

maria (eng-platform): Sounds reasonable. Proposal for rollout: behind opt-in header `X-Usage-Preview: cached-v1` initially, then GA after 6 weeks. I'll open the PR and include the docs change. Action items: @sam confirm accounting mapping and whether we need a reconciliation job for last month's data.

sam (billing): Confirmed mapping is fine. I will create a reconcile job to scan last 30 days for potential double-counting; will report back. Note: for customers on legacy contracts we might need to run migration to reclassify past invoices if we find discrepancies.

maria (eng-platform): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1234 — requesting quick CR from @kevin and @nina. Also added a small example in the PR description:

```
{
  "prompt_tokens": 120,
  "completion_tokens": 80,
  "cached_prompt_tokens": 30,   // optional
  "cached_completion_tokens": 0,
  "usage_schema_version": "2",
  "billing_basis": "billed = prompt + completion - cached_prompt"
}
```

kevin (runtime): I'll review today. One nit: change billing_basis string to a canonical enum (e.g., `billing_formula: "PROMPT+COMP - CACHED_PROMPT"`) so SDKs can parse it.

deploy-bot: canary deployed to staging, endpoint /v1/usage returns `usage_schema_version: 2` when `X-Usage-Preview: cached-v1` header present

maria (eng-platform): great — thanks all. I'll follow up once reconcile job results are in. :thumbsup:
